content: Allen CCFv3 axis convention (community/Allen docs): AP_CCF = -1*AP_mm*1000+5400 um; DV_CCF = DV_mm*1000 um; ML_CCF = ML_mm*1000+5700 um. Full brain extents roughly AP 0-13200um, DV 0-8000um, ML 0-11400um at 10um/voxel. TRAP2-specific background-subtraction method for Fos/TdTomato not found directly (paper source previously 403'd per Phase 2 STATE.md) -- not load-bearing since D-04's subtraction design is already user-locked, not literature-derived.
